what.prompt: Reply with the single word: ready
Explain in three short sentences why an append-only record of what an agent actually did is more trustworthy than a summary the agent writes about itself.
what.response: An append-only log can't be edited after the fact. It shows what the agent actually did, not what it claims. A self-summary can hide mistakes, but raw history cannot.

messages.content: In one sentence, name one thing an append-only record makes possible that a summary written by the agent itself cannot.

what.prompt: In one sentence, name one thing an append-only record makes possible that a summary written by the agent itself cannot.
what.response: An append-only record makes possible independent, tamper-evident verification of what actually happened.
